name: MULHOLLAND, Corinne

headline.note: Mulholland's first speech supplies a strong sequence: disaster-management work from 2006, local government from 2011 for almost eight and a half years, Queensland Inspector-General of Emergency Management leadership from September 2019, and a Star Entertainment corporate-affairs role from January 2022 followed by parental leave. Primary government and employer records corroborate roles and some dates. Exact hours, leave, earlier ministerial-office boundaries and several transitions remain unresolved. Political staff, volunteer governance, study and elected office are excluded; no public/private full-time total is yet defensible.

career_spells.employer: University of Queensland, Griffith University and College of Law Queensland
career_spells.role: Bachelor of Journalism, Juris Doctor and Graduate Diploma of Legal Practice student
career_spells.evidence_note: The official parliamentary biography lists the completed qualifications but no study dates or attendance pattern. A 2022–23 foundation annual report says the Juris Doctor was still being completed at that time. ALP2025 election post explicitly says she worked full-time while putting herself through university; employer and study dates are not identified, so the statement cannot assign full-time status across whole career spells. The foundation 2023–24 profile describes the Juris Doctor as completed, narrowing the documentary sequence from ongoing study in the prior report without supplying a graduation date or employer mapping.

career_spells.employer: Office of Pat Purcell MP, Queensland Minister for Emergency Services
career_spells.evidence_note: First speech places disaster-sector entry in2006. June2006 ministerial releases name her as media contact for Pat Purcell. Actual appointment and transfer dates/title/hours unknown; separated from later Neil Roberts office.
career_spells.counting_note: Political staff employment is excluded irrespective of public funding.

career_spells.role: Local-government roles, ultimately Manager, Strategy and Engagement
career_spells.evidence_note: Mulholland says she joined her local council in 2011 for flood recovery and worked in local government for almost eight and a half years. Council minutes identify her as Manager, Strategy and Engagement in June 2018; ABC gives the same role before the May 2019 election. The exact 2011 appointment, role progression, hours, leave and cessation are not published. Contemporary newspaper indexes on13-14September2018 describe stepping away from council work/on leave to campaign. Full articles were inaccessible, so actual leave commencement, pay, duration, return and final cessation remain unverified. Campaigning full time is not council working hours.
career_spells.counting_note: Public employment is well supported, but year-only boundaries and missing full-time/leave evidence prevent counting.

career_spells.employer: Office of the Inspector-General of Emergency Management, Queensland
career_spells.evidence_note: The 2019–20 report records appointment on 30 September 2019. The 2020–21 annual report identifies Mulholland in the substantive executive-leadership role and describes responsibility for media, internal communication, strategic partnerships, research and engagement, plus oversight of monitoring, evaluation, review and assurance activities. The 2021–22 report names her as director and Ian Thompson relieving from December 2021; the relief is not proof of resignation or payroll cessation. Removed inferred January 2022 end drawn from Star commencement; leave, overlap, hours and full-time status remain unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: The role and public control are established, but the end boundary and full-time/leave evidence are insufficient.

career_spells.role: Head of Public Affairs (Queensland); General Manager Public Affairs Queensland; elsewhere described as General Manager, Corporate Affairs
career_spells.evidence_note: The Common Good's January 2023 announcement and 2022–23 annual report identify Mulholland as Star's Head of Public Affairs Queensland. A 2024 interview reports that she worked as General Manager of Corporate Affairs from January 2022, commenced parental leave in September 2023 and was no longer employed by Star by the interview. Exact title transition, leave/pay status, cessation and hours are not published. The foundation 2023–24 report uses General Manager Public Affairs Queensland, adding a distinct published title. Its description is not a dated promotion or proof of continued work through the reporting or publication date, and could be a retained profile during parental leave; preserve the later interview cessation account pending payroll evidence.
career_spells.counting_note: The private role is supported but parental leave and final payroll boundaries must be resolved before counting.

career_spells.employer: The Prince Charles Hospital Foundation / The Common Good
career_spells.evidence_note: 2024–25 annual report explicitly records retirement30June2025, replacing the previously encoded prospective2026 term end. Individual board table records no fees and voluntary service; report identifies statutory government body under Hospital Foundations Act2018. Excluded governance.
career_spells.counting_note: Volunteer governance is excluded from substantive employment totals.

career_spells.evidence_note: Official parliamentary service began on 1 July 2025 following election to the Senate.

career_spells.employer: Office of Neil Roberts MP, Queensland
career_spells.role: Senior Policy Advisor; earlier ministerial media role
career_spells.evidence_note: A 28 October 2008 release identifies Mulholland as a ministerial-office contact. A 15 April 2010 signed ministerial submission explicitly names her as Senior Policy Advisor in Neil Roberts's office. A February 2012 valedictory thanks her among senior staff but does not prove that she remained employed then. Appointment, exact title-change and cessation dates, hours and the possible 2011 council overlap remain unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Excluded category; not added to public/private employment headlines.

career_spells.counting_note: Excluded category; not added to public/private employment headlines.

research_notes: Identify every 2006–12 Queensland ministerial/public-sector appointment, title, employing authority, exact dates, hours and overlap with Moreton Bay Regional Council; do not merge political staff with public service.
Obtain Moreton Bay Regional Council appointment, role progression, full-time status, leave and exact cessation, including the 2019 federal campaign arrangement.
Confirm IGEM full-time status and exact cessation/leave between the last 2021 record and January 2022 Star commencement.
Resolve Star title progression, hours, September 2023 parental-leave pay/status and exact employment cessation before the 2025 campaign.
Verify actual board service end and whether any governance remuneration existed; it remains excluded regardless of volunteer service.

2026-10-02 follow-up: separated Purcell and Roberts ministerial offices;2012 valedictory is acknowledgement not proof of current staff status. PrimaryIGEM2021–22 report identifies relieving director fromDecember2021, but not payroll end; inferredend removed. Foundation2024–25 report resolves retirement30June2025 and nil fees; inherited invalid governance category replaced with approved unpaid_work. Added community ambassador, youth-program board and teenage volunteering. ALP statement establishes some full-time employment during university, but lack of study dates/employer mapping prevents allocating it to council, IGEM or Star. Public Facebook full-page Internal Error recovered via indexed official post. Star leave, final cessation and council campaign arrangements still unresolved; no totals calculated.

2026-10-03 follow-up: the primary IGEM 2020–21 annual report adds substantive executive-leadership duties across media, internal communication, strategic partnerships, research, engagement and assurance. It does not resolve weekly hours, leave or the December2021 relief/January2022 Star transition. Fresh searches of council-campaign leave and Star parental-leave/cessation repeated existing reports or inaccessible paywalled material; no boundary inferred.

2026-10-04 follow-up: a signed Neil Roberts ministerial submission dated 15 April 2010 identifies Mulholland as Senior Policy Advisor, refining the previously generic ministerial-media/senior-staff record. It supplies a dated observation only; exact appointment, title progression, hours, cessation and possible 2011 council overlap remain unresolved. Star, council and parental-leave searches otherwise repeated existing annual reports and reporting; no final Star payroll boundary or council campaign-leave record surfaced.

2026-10-05 primary annual-report follow-up: the Prince Charles Hospital Foundation 2023–24 report, printed p18, adds the distinct Star title General Manager Public Affairs Queensland and describes the Juris Doctor as completed. Neither is converted into a promotion, graduation or payroll date; a retained board profile during leave could conflict with later cessation reporting. IGEM2021–22 financial notes6 and staff statistics were examined: remuneration is by position and aggregate FTE includes part-time staff, so it cannot establish her personal full-time status or final payroll boundary. Corrected charity-board classification to nonprofit governance with pay unknown, preserving exclusion. Council appointment, Star parental-leave/pay and final cessation remain unresolved. No totals calculated.

Second targeted follow-up 2026-10-05: new contemporary2018 council campaign-leave newspaper indexes attached to the council spell. Canberra Times full text returned402 Payment Required; Quest returned Failed to fetch restricted URL. These are source-specific gaps, not job-wide errors. Third-party social reposts mention a prospective September17 leave start but are not accepted as actual commencement evidence. A6March2019 Quest index mentions resignation in an article about a council director; full context unavailable, so no Mulholland cessation assigned from that ambiguous fragment. Council payroll leave/pay/return and Star parental-leave end remain unresolved.
